description:
Use this tool after a video post has been submitted through posts.publish_post and the response contains a video_token.

It checks whether video publication has finished and returns the status for each target account.

Possible statuses:
- pending
- failed
- successful

The response may include a publish_url after successful publication.

Use the video_token returned by posts.publish_post. If the status is pending, check again later. Do not retrieve post insights until successful publication has been confirmed and a publish_url is available.

video_token.description: Video token returned when the video upload was created.

name: videos.status
title: Check video publishing status
